|translation='''Title:''' FX-10 (Effex-ten).

'''Subtype:''' Medical droid.

'''Card text:''' Once per turn, one non-droid character hit by a weapon at the same or an adjacent location may be moved to the Used Deck instead of the Lost Deck.

'''Lore:''' A standard medical droid deployed with Imperial field units. Enhanced programming lets FX-10 treat many kinds of wounds that may occur in battle.
